Skills

Skills are special attributes applied to matches that can affect gameplay. There are four types of Skills: Offensive, Economy, Strategy and Defense. They are unlocked at Level 15.

  • 1 Mechanics
    • 1.1 Resetting Skills
  • 2 Skills

Mechanics

  • All Skills unlocked
  • Fully upgraded Skills

Skills will apply buffs to the player's towers and units. These start off small and linearly become slightly higher. Each Skill has its own level cap, some being as low as 10 and others having up to 40 levels. In the majority of cases, they only apply to the player who has the Skill and not every single player in the match. However, if the thing that the Skill affects is shared by the players, it will function in various ways, like including Skill boosts from every player or only picking the one with the highest Level.

Each Skill will start out very cheap, but it will quickly become far more expensive as the equation for the cost is exponential. It is calculated as:
(Base Cost×Level)Exponential Value
The result is first rounded down then rounded to the nearest multiple of 5.

The total cost to fully upgrade every Skill is 824,070. To have every single Skill available to upgrade, the player has to purchase every single Skill except Precision, Scavenger, Scholar, Re-enforcements and Beefed Up Minions, and level them up to Level 10, which would have a total cost of 48,195. The lowest amount of currency required to have every Skill for a specific path unlocked will be listed separately in each Skill section.

After the player unlocks a Skill from a specific path, a modifier for that path will appear, applying the effects for the player. The description of the modifier will list every single Skill owned and how much it boosts specific statistics.

In the Settings, it is possible to disable Skills with the Skills Enabled setting.

Hidden Wave cannot be activated with skills enabled. Certain modes, like Voidcore or PVP, also disable Skills.

Resetting Skills

If the player is unsatisfied with what Skills they spent their currency on, they have the option to reset their Skills. While this will not bring back their Coins, it will give them back in the form of Skill Credits. These are a unique currency only usable for Skills. The player is only given back 95% of what they spent, and they have to pay 200 to reset Skills. Each reset will become more expensive by 200.

After resetting, Skills are unable to be upgraded using Coins, they are restricted to only Skill Credits. Once the player has run out of possible upgrades, the method of upgrading Skills is Coins again.

Skills

Offensive

Offensive-oriented Skills that allow towers to deal more damage.

  • The lowest cost needed to be able to upgrade any of the Skills is 12,730, which is the cost for upgrading all Skills except Precision to Level 10.
  • The total cost for unlocking every Level is 190,835.

Precision - 15 Levels

"Every X Enemies shots, a tower deals a critical hit (1.25x damage). Cannot stack with other critical hit towers."
Every 29th tower shot will be a critical hit that deals 1.25x damage, with the number of shots decreasing by 1 with each upgrade. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Fight Dirty before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 7 with an exponential value of 2.035.

Each enemy hit by a tower counts as a shot. For example, each enemy hit by the Electroshocker's lightning increases the hit counter. Does not stack with critical hits from the Brawler or Warden, but does stack with Slasher's crits. Some splash towers, these being the Paintballer, Demoman, Rocketeer, Mortar and Snowballer cannot crit either, but other towers like the Firework Technician can crit. Secondary attacks like Pursuit's missiles do not work, with the exception of the Swarmer's Bee Swarm Grenade, Elementalist's Heatwave and Archer's explosion. Damage over time does not crit. Units are unable to deal crits. The Accelerator, Trapper and DJ Booth are also unable to crit.

"Reduces stun and debuff durations from enemies by X%."

Beefed Up Minions - 25 Levels

"Health of summoned units is increased by X%."
Increases unit's health by 0.6% for each purchase. Only applies to units summoned by towers, units summoned through other sources, like consumables, are not affected. There is a requirement of reaching Level 10 in Extreme Conditioning before it is unlocked. Has a base cost of 6 with an exponential value of 1.68.

Things which deal unit collision damage or function very similarly to units but are not classified as units, like the Barricade, Sandcastle, Hacker's converted enemies and Trapper traps are not affected.

Trivia

  • Skills are as expensive as they are for the purpose of acting as a coin sink; players are not actually expected to fully upgrade every single Skill.[1]

Update History

  • 28 May 2025 - v1.65.0
    • Skills added.
    • Bug: Units will have decimal health when affected by Beefed Up Minions.
    • Bug: Enhanced Optics will cause the range statistic of towers to show inaccurate range, making it look like the range is boosted by Expanded Barracks instead. The range visuals and the actual area towers attack enemies in are, however, not boosted by the Expanded Barracks, they are correctly boosted based on what Enhanced Optics is upgraded to.
    • Bug: Enhanced Optics Range Buff will be visually the same for every player as you, even though in reality every player has their own Enhanced Optics Range Buff applied.
    • Bug: Precision is always active, even when Skills are disabled or when the player does not even have it unlocked.
    • Bug: Scavenger is always active, even when Skills are disabled or when the player does not even have it unlocked.
    • Bug: Bigger Budget sometimes will not apply its starting cash boost.
    • Bug: Fortify can bypass mode base health limits.
    • Bug: Fortify, Over-Heal and Bandages do not pick the Skill of the player which has it upgraded to the highest Level, but instead the latest player.
    • Bug: Skills will randomly be shown as not unlocked even though they are actually unlocked.
  • 13 June 2025 - v1.67.3
    • Refunds were given out to players, all upgrades which were discounted will now give back the difference between the older more expensive price and the new cheaper price.
      • For Fortify, the last 10 Levels are not refunded as they were removed. Because of this, the maximum refund possible is 803,600 instead of the expected 826,460.
    • Restarting Skills added. 95% of the currency spent is converted into Skill Credits. Restarting costs 200, with the cost increasing by 200 each restart.
    • Adjustments:
      • As a result of these adjustments, total unlock cost has been reduced from 1,650,530 to 824,070.
      • Enhanced Optics
        • Base cost decreased from 9 to 6.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.73.
      • Improved Gunpowder
        • Base cost decreased from 7 to 5.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.725.
        • Explosion radius increase decreased from 0.8% to 0.5%.
      • Fight Dirty
        • Base cost decreased from 8 to 5.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.78 to 1.77.
      • Precision
        • Base cost decreased from 11 to 7.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.98 to 2.035.
        • Starting shots decreased from 39 to 29.
        • Visual effects added.
      • Resourcefulness
        • Base cost decreased from 7 to 4.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.74 to 1.75.
      • Bigger Budget
        • Base cost decreased from 7 to 4.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.75 to 1.82.
      • Stonks
        • Base cost decreased from 10 to 7.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.8 to 1.78.
      • Scavenger
        • Base cost decreased from 10 to 7.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.85 to 1.865.
        • Visual effects added.
      • Accelerator
        • Base cost decreased from 6 to 4.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.8 to 1.77.
      • Scholar
        • Base cost decreased from 9 to 5.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.85 to 1.83.
      • Expanded Barracks
        • Base cost decreased from 9 to 6.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.85 to 1.86.
        • Spawnrate reduction decreased from 1% to 0.75%.
      • Fortify
        • Base cost decreased from 5 to 3.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.425 to 1.4.
        • Levels reduced from 50 to 40.
        • Base health increase decreased from 6 to 5.
      • Over-Heal
        • Base cost decreased from 8 to 5.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.65 to 1.7.
        • Over-heal boost increased from 4 to 8.
      • Bandages
        • Base cost decreased from 8 to 5.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.685 to 1.7.
      • Extreme Conditioning
        • Base cost decreased from 8 to 5.
        • Exponential value increased from 1.7 to 1.725.
      • Beefed Up Minions
        • Base cost decreased from 9 to 6.
        • Exponential value decreased from 1.7 to 1.68.
        • Unit health boost decreased from 0.75% to 0.6%.
    • Bug: After Skill cost prices have been refunded, some players received decimal currency.
    • Bug: After the Skill tree refund, it will visually appear as fully incomplete until the player rejoins or upgrades a Skill.
    • Bug: If the player does not have enough Coins but has enough Skill Credits to purchase an upgrade, the button will be visually red despite the player actually being able to purchase it.
    • Bug: If the player attempts to upgrade a Skill after restarting while its cost is higher than both their current Coins and Skill Credits amounts, the Skill will not be purchased and all the Skill Credits will disappear.
  • 18 June 2025 - v1.67.6
    • Bugfix: Skills can no longer refund decimal Coins.
  • 25 June 2025 - v1.68.0
    • Requirement of Level 15 added.
    • Updated music.
  • 19 June 2026 - v2.1.0
    • Bugfix: Enhanced Optics range boost is now properly displayed in the upgrade menu.
  • 21 August 2026 - v2.7.0
    • Corrected receive being misspelled as "recieve" in the refund pop-up.
